questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word showing position above?
explanation: Above is the correct spelling - A-B-O-V-E. Above means at a higher level or position than something else.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word showing position under?
explanation: Below is the correct spelling - B-E-L-O-W. Below means at a lower level or position than something else.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning at the back?
explanation: Behind is the correct spelling - B-E-H-I-N-D. Behind means at the back of something.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning at the side of?
explanation: Beside is the correct spelling - B-E-S-I-D-E. Beside means at the side of something or someone.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning from one side to the other?
explanation: Across is the correct spelling - A-C-R-O-S-S. Across means from one side to the other side of something.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning in the middle of?
explanation: Between is the correct spelling - B-E-T-W-E-E-N. Between means in the space separating two things.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning from one end to the other?
explanation: Through is the correct spelling - T-H-R-O-U-G-H. Through means moving in one side and out the other.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning in all parts of?
explanation: Throughout is the correct spelling - T-H-R-O-U-G-H-O-U-T. Throughout means in every part of, or during the whole of.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning at all times?
explanation: Always is the correct spelling - A-L-W-A-Y-S. Always means at all times, on every occasion.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning at no time?
explanation: Never is the correct spelling - N-E-V-E-R. Never means at no time, not ever.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning under something?
explanation: Underneath is the correct spelling - U-N-D-E-R-N-E-A-T-H. Underneath means directly below or beneath something.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning by the side of and going with?
explanation: Alongside is the correct spelling - A-L-O-N-G-S-I-D-E. Alongside means next to and along the side of something.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning in the direction of?
explanation: Toward is the correct spelling - T-O-W-A-R-D. Toward means in the direction of a place or person.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning not far away?
explanation: Nearby is the correct spelling - N-E-A-R-B-Y. Nearby means close to a particular place.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning already done?
explanation: Already is the correct spelling - A-L-R-E-A-D-Y. Already means before or by this time.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning as well?
explanation: Also is the correct spelling - A-L-S-O. Also means in addition to something already mentioned.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning from time to time?
explanation: Often is the correct spelling - O-F-T-E-N. Often means many times, on many occasions.

questionText: Choose the correctly spelled word: 'She _____ finishes her homework before dinner.'
explanation: Usually is the correct spelling - U-S-U-A-L-L-Y. Usually means under normal conditions, most of the time. It has double L.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning not here?
explanation: Elsewhere is the correct spelling - E-L-S-E-W-H-E-R-E. Elsewhere means in, at, or to some other place.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning moving ahead?
explanation: Forward is the correct spelling - F-O-R-W-A-R-D. Forward means towards the front or in the direction one is facing.

questionText: One of these prepositions or adverbs is spelled INCORRECTLY. Which one?
explanation: Allready is spelled incorrectly. The correct spelling is already - A-L-R-E-A-D-Y. Underneath, alongside, and elsewhere are all correct.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning even so?
explanation: Nevertheless is the correct spelling - N-E-V-E-R-T-H-E-L-E-S-S. Nevertheless means in spite of that, despite what was just said.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning following that?
explanation: Subsequently is the correct spelling - S-U-B-S-E-Q-U-E-N-T-L-Y. Subsequently means coming after something in order or time.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning roughly?
explanation: Approximately is the correct spelling - A-P-P-R-O-X-I-M-A-T-E-L-Y. Approximately means close to, but not exactly. It has double P.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning right away?
explanation: Immediately is the correct spelling - I-M-M-E-D-I-A-T-E-L-Y. Immediately means without any delay. It has double M.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning now and then?
explanation: Occasionally is the correct spelling - O-C-C-A-S-I-O-N-A-L-L-Y. Occasionally means from time to time, not regularly. It has double C and double L.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning very often?
explanation: Frequently is the correct spelling - F-R-E-Q-U-E-N-T-L-Y. Frequently means very often, occurring many times.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning as a result?
explanation: Consequently is the correct spelling - C-O-N-S-E-Q-U-E-N-T-L-Y. Consequently means as a result of an action or event.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning at the same time?
explanation: Simultaneously is the correct spelling - S-I-M-U-L-T-A-N-E-O-U-S-L-Y. Simultaneously means happening at the same time.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning in the end?
explanation: Eventually is the correct spelling - E-V-E-N-T-U-A-L-L-Y. Eventually means in the end, especially after a long time. It has double L.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning without stopping?
explanation: Continuously is the correct spelling - C-O-N-T-I-N-U-O-U-S-L-Y. Continuously means without interruption.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning sadly?
explanation: Unfortunately is the correct spelling - U-N-F-O-R-T-U-N-A-T-E-L-Y. Unfortunately means it is unfortunate that, used to express regret.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning in a way that is not usual?
explanation: Extraordinarily is the correct spelling - E-X-T-R-A-O-R-D-I-N-A-R-I-L-Y. Extraordinarily means to a remarkably great extent.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning in a way that is separate?
explanation: Independently is the correct spelling - I-N-D-E-P-E-N-D-E-N-T-L-Y. Independently means without outside help or control.

questionText: One of these words is spelled INCORRECTLY. Which one?
explanation: Immedietely is spelled incorrectly. The correct spelling is immediately - I-M-M-E-D-I-A-T-E-L-Y. Nevertheless, subsequently, and approximately are all correct.

questionText: One of these words is spelled INCORRECTLY. Which one?
explanation: Occasionaly is spelled incorrectly. The correct spelling is occasionally - O-C-C-A-S-I-O-N-A-L-L-Y. Consequently, simultaneously, and frequently are all correct.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning inside?
explanation: Within is the correct spelling - W-I-T-H-I-N. Within means inside the limits of something.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning going against?
explanation: Against is the correct spelling - A-G-A-I-N-S-T. Against means in opposition to or touching the surface of.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning with special attention?
explanation: Particularly is the correct spelling - P-A-R-T-I-C-U-L-A-R-L-Y. Particularly means to a higher degree than usual.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning in addition?
explanation: Additionally is the correct spelling - A-D-D-I-T-I-O-N-A-L-L-Y. Additionally means as an extra thing, in addition. It starts with double D.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning in a clear way?
explanation: Specifically is the correct spelling - S-P-E-C-I-F-I-C-A-L-L-Y. Specifically means in a way that is exact and particular. It has double L.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning in a circle around?
explanation: Around is the correct spelling - A-R-O-U-N-D. Around means on all sides of, or in a circular direction.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning while an event happens?
explanation: During is the correct spelling - D-U-R-I-N-G. During means throughout the course or duration of something.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning on the inside?
explanation: Inside is the correct spelling - I-N-S-I-D-E. Inside means on the inner side or surface of something.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning on the outside?
explanation: Outside is the correct spelling - O-U-T-S-I-D-E. Outside means on or to the exterior side.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning below the surface?
explanation: Beneath is the correct spelling - B-E-N-E-A-T-H. Beneath means directly under something.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning in a backward direction?
explanation: Backward is the correct spelling - B-A-C-K-W-A-R-D. Backward means directed or moving towards the back.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning not yet?
explanation: Yet is the correct spelling - Y-E-T. Yet means up until now, or by this time.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning even now?
explanation: Still is the correct spelling - S-T-I-L-L. Still means continuing up to and including the present time. It ends with double L.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning to that place?
explanation: There is the correct spelling - T-H-E-R-E. There means in, at, or to that place.
